themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: The chip index fell 6.72% on Oct 22 to 10,731.98, its weakest close since July 29, with all 30 members down. Lam fell 11.8% after its CEO said clean room space and component shortages will limit chipmakers into 2027, and Nvidia's CEO said neocloud customers lack the working capital to fund their growth. Meta's 10-Q showed about $825 billion of future lease and contract commitments, up from about $700 billion in July, and its five year credit default swap hit a record.
themes.for_you: No new AI chip swings or puts this week. NVDA (212.21) and MRVL (223.47) slipped from 'Buy zone now' to 'wait for the chart' on Oct 22 closes. LRCX is Wait at 230.15, below its 274.39 zone bottom. Wait for buyers to return on volume before any long term add.

themes.name: AI power and the grid
themes.what: Bloom Energy reported Q3 on Oct 22: revenue $1.24 billion, up 138%, adjusted EPS $0.94 against about $0.69 expected, and a third raise of 2026 revenue guidance to $4.4 to $4.6 billion. But free cash flow was negative $181 million in the quarter, and the stock had already fallen 8.7% to 217.77 that day. Comfort Systems posted a record $17.81 billion backlog, up from $14.06 billion in June, yet fell about 5% after hours. GE Vernova fell 10.6% to 827.42 on 2.56x normal volume as Meta's spending stoked worries about how AI sites get financed.
themes.for_you: BE is 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' at 217.77 (zone 212.29 to 238.53) with sellers leading (0.82): no put while cash burn is the story. GEV dropped from 'Buy zone now' to Wait and reports Oct 28 before the open: no new position before then. BE and FIX are left out of both lists because the business numbers were strong but the cash and the stock reaction were weak.

themes.name: Fintech and Crypto Rails: Stablecoins, Tokenization, Exchanges
themes.what: American Express reported Q3 on Oct 23: record revenue of $20.1 billion, up 9%, GAAP EPS $5.42, adjusted EPS $4.68 against about $4.58 expected, billed business up 8% to $454.0 billion, and a higher 2026 EPS guide (company release).
themes.for_you: AXP is 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' at 325.17 on Oct 22 (zone 316.05 to 328.58) because sellers led (up/down 0.84). A close up on heavy volume after this report could flip it. No put idea until the verdict is 'Buy zone now'.

themes.name: Healthcare and Medtech: Aging, Heart, Sugar, Hearing, Sight
themes.what: Leaked melanoma data on Oct 22 showed Moderna and Merck's personalized vaccine (intismeran) plus Keytruda cut the risk of recurrence or death by 42% against Keytruda alone; 82.2% of patients were alive and cancer free at two years against 70%. Overall survival is not yet mature. Moderna fell about 18% to 20% and Merck 1.8% in a sell the news move; full data comes Oct 24 in Madrid. On the same risk off day medtech rose: ISRG up 3.7% to 443.85, ZBH 4.2%, PODD 4.4%, MDT 3.8% (dashboard).
themes.for_you: No action on MRK; it has no dashboard verdict. ZBH (98.81) and PODD (148.12) are 'Buy zone now'; ZBH closed just above its 97.86 zone top, so add only on a dip back into the zone. ISRG's verdict turned to Wait only because the $450 million settlement charge made earnings look like they shrank; treat that as a data quirk, not a new reason to sell.

innovations.name: Energy
innovations.what: Bloom Energy's Q3 (Oct 22) showed behind the meter power is selling: product revenue crossed $1 billion for the first time ($1.07 billion, up 179%), total revenue rose 138% to $1.24 billion, and 2026 revenue guidance rose to $4.4 to $4.6 billion. The catch is cash: the quarter used $181 million of free cash flow as inventory and receivables grew.
innovations.for_you: BE is left out of both lists: demand is proven, but the stock fell 8.7% before the report and more after hours on the cash burn. It is 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' at 217.77; wait for up/down volume above 1.0.

innovations.name: Transportation
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. On its Oct 21 call Tesla said its Austin Cybercab fleet grew about 10 times since the early September launch, neared 2 million cumulative unsupervised miles, and should reach Dallas next month, with first customer Cybercab deliveries targeted by end of 2026. It also cut 2026 capex to about $20 billion. The FAA drone rule (Part 108) is still at White House review past its Oct 8 window, and neither Joby nor Archer has confirmed a paying passenger.
innovations.for_you: No action. TSLA is Avoid on valuation (374.58 on Oct 22). Tesla's progress is real but small next to Waymo's 500,000 rides a week; UBER and GOOGL are left out because a second robotaxi network both competes with and supplies ride platforms.

countries.name: Argentina
countries.what: Argentina's country risk rose to 709 points on Oct 22 and the official dollar sold at a nominal record 1,550 pesos at Banco Nacion (wholesale 1,528), while the Merval fell 1.5% to 97,993 as the tech sell off hit ADRs (Rio Times).
countries.for_you: No action. No Argentine stock is on the buy zone list. Bank ADRs suffer first when the peso slides; energy names like YPF and PAM earn in dollars and are left out of the bearish list.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.what: Final polls before the Oct 25 runoff show a dead heat: Datafolha has Flavio Bolsonaro and Lula at 50% each of valid votes (released Oct 22, down from 51% to 49% a week earlier), and PoderData has Flavio at 51% to 49% (released Oct 22, down from a 4 point lead). Markets have priced a Bolsonaro win, so a Lula win is the bigger surprise.
countries.for_you: No NU buys or puts before Monday. NU is 'Buy zone now' at 14.73 on Oct 22 (zone 14.11 to 15.03). If Lula wins and NU gaps toward 14.11, that is the level to watch; if Flavio wins, wait for the gap to settle.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Brent settled up about 4% at $113.17 on Oct 22, its highest close since May 4, and WTI rose 2.4% to $99.47, after the Saudi attacks and the US order for some diplomats to leave (Bloomberg via Rigzone). Kpler reported Hormuz flows near prewar levels, so this is a risk premium. SLB said on Oct 23 its Middle East revenue rose 13% from Q2.
countries.for_you: If you hold energy swings, keep the dashboard stops (XOM 162.99, CVX 210.45); buyers still lead (up/down 1.45 and 1.18 on Oct 22). XOM and CVX both report Oct 30, so no new energy swings or puts into that date.

countries.name: Japan
countries.what: The Nikkei fell about 2.7% on Oct 22 as Tokyo Electron, SoftBank Group and Kioxia were sold with US chips, then slipped 0.34% to 62,693.16 on Oct 23, down from 64,621.24 on Oct 21 (CNBC).
countries.for_you: No action. Advantest (6857.T) is 'Accumulate on pullback' and is left out of both lists because its own close was not found. Wait for the chip sell off to settle. The BOJ meets Oct 30.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.what: SK hynix halted the review of a pre IPO round and Nasdaq listing for its US NAND unit Solidigm, easing worries about a duplicate listing; the stock rose about 4.4% and lifted the KOSPI 0.30% to 5,550.30 on Oct 23 after an early 2.36% drop. Foreign investors were net sellers of 994.1 billion won. SK hynix reports Q3 before 9am Seoul time on Oct 28, which is 8pm ET on Oct 27.
countries.for_you: No action. The US listed Korea names are left out because the move was about SK hynix, which does not trade in the US. Its report Monday night US time is the first big memory read of the week.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.what: The Taiex fell 846.34 points, or 1.81%, to 46,041.43 on Oct 22 as US chip stocks fell 6.72%. Taipei's market was closed on Oct 23 for Typhoon Champi, so local stocks will catch up with two days of US moves on Monday.
countries.for_you: The Setups scanner listed an EWT 100 put for Nov 20 on Oct 22. If you sold it, Monday's open is the risk because Taiwan has not traded since Thursday. No new Taiwan puts until it does. TSM is left out because its own sales news has not changed.
